claims.quote: What would be the reason for this loss? We don't usually handle it gracefully when someone was fiddling with the local data.

status_by.quote: Whatever the cause (a partial copy of a blocks directory, or a storage fault taking out the one small file sitting next to the large stable ones)

claims.quote: This seems a bit involved to me. From what I can tell from your description the actual problem is that the current corruption detection logic will prompt a user to reindex if the block files themselves cannot be read properly. I think it would be preferable to improve that instead, i.e. either crashing or shutting down in a way that does not trigger the reindex prompt.
claims.request: Improve corruption detection to crash or shut down without prompting a reindex instead of this approach
